construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit H24-042 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2024), status Approved, issue date 2025-03-12: "Site Development Permit to allow the demolition of two vacant commercial buildings, totaling approximately 50,900 square feet, and the removal of 56 trees (14 ordinance and 42 non-ordinance trees), for the construction of a six-story multifamily residenti" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

CEQA Notice of Exemption (SCH 2025030811): Site Development Permit to demolish two vacant commercial buildings (about 50,900 sq ft) and remove 59 trees (17 ordinance trees) for a six-story, 400-unit, 100% affordable multifamily building with podium parking on about 3.4 gross acres, about 600 ft west of South White Road; categorical exemption under CEQA Guidelines 15332. The city GIS permit text on this record shows 56 trees (14 ordinance).

San José Spotlight: approved at a Planning Director hearing on March 12, 2025; green and open space requirements were waived; homes expected to be affordable at 80% AMI; a 24/7 all-electric car-share program; traffic-calming budget raised from $40,000 to $100,000; site formerly a drive-in restaurant, The Golden Point; developer said it was too early to discuss financing.
AO project page describes a 100% affordable modular housing community on the former Orchard Supply Hardware site.
